meta.name: verification-gate
meta.description: Verification gate before claiming task completion. No completion claim without fresh evidence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证任务完成前必须提供最新证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交工作成果前自动验证证据有效性。
copy.tagline_en: Verify task completion with fresh evidence before claiming done.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically verify evidence before claiming task completion.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在声称任务完成前，必须先运行验证命令（如测试、构建）并展示最新证据，否则不能声称完成。
howto.when: 在做出任何成功声明、满意度表达、提交代码或进入下一任务前触发。

say.text: 运行测试并展示结果，再告诉我是否通过。
say.note: Claude 会执行测试命令并输出结果。

say.text: 检查代码审查报告，列出所有问题。
say.note: Claude 会启动审查子代理并生成报告。

say.text: 验证这个 bug 是否已修复，运行原始症状测试。
say.note: Claude 会运行测试并对比结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude must run verification commands (e.g., tests, build) and show fresh evidence before claiming task completion; otherwise, no completion claim is allowed.
howto.when_en: Triggered before any success/completion claim, satisfaction expression, commit, PR creation, or moving to the next task.

say_en.text: Run the tests and show results, then tell me if they pass.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the test command and output results.

say_en.text: Review the code and list all issues.
say_en.note: Claude will spawn a reviewer subagent and generate a report.

say_en.text: Verify the bug fix by running the original symptom test.
say_en.note: Claude will run the test and compare results.
